purpose: Position the adjacent-minor propagation theorem inside standard commutative-ring rank-one algebra, preserve the load-bearing unit hypothesis, and decide whether its finite-selector compression warrants an independent exact proposition firewall.

classification.nearest_prior_work: Călugăreanu (2025), Theorem 1, places vanishing 2-by-2 minors over commutative rings in the rank-one determinantal family; Section 3 explicitly warns that vanishing minors need not yield a column-row decomposition over an arbitrary ring. The local unit coordinate supplies an affine-chart factorization directly.
classification.mathematical_interest: The algebra is elementary, but the interface is sharp and reusable: a local adjacent-minor check plus units forces global pairwise collapse and reduces a finite selector search from N-squared vector states to N scalar states.
classification.reusable_scope: Sequences in R-squared over any commutative ring with a unit anchor at each row; finite-selector compression over Z/NZ; source-specific two-three depth conversion as a subordinate corollary.
classification.why_it_matters: It isolates exactly what determinantal information can reduce a modular pigeonhole budget and prevents invalid rank-one propagation in the presence of zero divisors.

primary_sources.title: The formula ABA=Tr(AB)A for matrices
primary_sources.author: Grigore Călugăreanu
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Theorem 1 characterizes matrices over a commutative ring whose 2-by-2 minors vanish via ABA=Tr(AB)A for every B. Section 3, especially the paragraph following the inner-rank-one proof, states that all 2-by-2 minors vanishing does not in general imply a column-row decomposition over an arbitrary commutative ring.
primary_sources.supports: The standard rank-one/determinantal setting and the need for an additional ring-theoretic or unit-chart hypothesis before claiming factorization.
primary_sources.does_not_support: It does not state adjacent-to-global propagation for a sequence, the finite-selector threshold, the two-three depth conversion, or any q-Apéry application.

mechanism_comparison.classical_core: All 2-by-2 minors vanishing is the determinantal rank-one condition, but over general commutative rings it need not produce a column-row factorization.
mechanism_comparison.authored_exact_delta: A unit second coordinate gives an explicit affine-chart scalar for each adjacent step, so local minor vanishing propagates globally without imposing a domain hypothesis.
mechanism_comparison.finite_consumer: Once every row lies on the anchor line over Z/NZ, binary selector sums occupy at most N states rather than N-squared states.
mechanism_comparison.source_specific_boundary: The q-Apéry programme must still prove uniform units, valuations, analytic height decay, and nonvanishing.
